richiami.difetto: In order for proper regeneration of the Diesel Particle Filter (DPF) system the vehicle in the active regeneration mode directs the driver by illuminating the DPF warning light to drive the vehicle at constant speed without interruption until the DPF warning light turns off. In the event that the driver ignores the DPF warning light and the corresponding direction the DPF system as well as exhaust pipe will be abnormally overheated. This may cause a fire at the Lower Engine Compartment Cover located near the DPF system and exhaust pipe.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and initially remove and discard the Lower Engine Compartment Cover. When parts are available the vehicles will be recalled to have the new Lower Engine Compartment Cover fitted.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY OF FIRE

The concern only affects vehicles with manual transmission.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit a modified ignition Key cylinder.

richiami.difetto: null Under certain conditions there is a risk that the ignition switch in the vehicles may move out of the “run” position, resulting in a partial loss of electrical power and turning off the engine. This risk may increase if the key ring is carrying added weight (such as more keys or the key fob) or the vehicle experiences rough road conditions or other jarring or impact related events. When the ignition switch is not in the run position, the air bags may not deploy if the vehicle is involved in a crash, increasing the risk of injury or fatality.  Some vehicles may also have a condition in which the ignition key may be removed when the ignition is not in the “Off” position. In such an event, unintended vehicle motion may occur, resulting in a vehicle crash and occupant or pedestrian injuries.

richiami.difetto: Incorrect type of brake fluid installed at production could cause internal corrosion of the ABS module. This corrosion can lead to a gel build up inside the module which may affect the closing motion of one of the valves. There will be no external loss of fluid or reduction in fluid level but it is possible the driver could feel excessive brake pedal travel. In some circumstances there may be reduced braking performance.
richiami.rimedio: Inspection of the brake fluid using a scan tool. Drain and replace the fluid and replace the brake fluid reservoir cap  (All models except Captiva & Epica/Tosca). Erase ''DOT 3'' text from the customers Owner's Manual (All models except Captiva & Epica/Tosca). Add  information regarding the use of DOT 4 brake fluid.
richiami.titolo: BRAKING EFFICIENCY MAY BE AFFECTED

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that in rare cases repeated movement of the steering column may cause a signal interruption within the column. If this occurs it can affect the Active Handling System which can cause instability within the vehicle. The driver will be identified of the issue by the illumination of warnings lights on the dash. However if the driver does not take action then a crash could occur.
richiami.rimedio: Inspect the wire connection in the steering column and if necessary install an additional clip to secure the wire connection.
richiami.titolo: BRAKES MAY APPLY INADVERTENTLY

This may lead to failure to properly engage the seatbelt buckle which would mean that the occupant would not be restrained in case of an accident.
richiami.omologazione_grezza: The recall concerns 2009-2010 model year vehicles with VINs in the range from KL1MJ6A04A C113537 to KL1MJ61079C699761.

richiami.difetto: The brake light switch may become maladjusted if an upward force is inadvertently applied to the brake pedal. This may cause the brake lights to remain illuminated without the brake being applied. If ignored this condition may result in the vehicle being driven with the brake lights permanently illuminated. Also if affected the brake lights may remain illuminated with the vehicle ignition switched off which may result in a discharged battery.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit a modified brake lamp switch.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY THAT BRAKE LIGHTS MAY STAY ON
